balanceNotes: The three earned first hours remain active and profitable without automatic production. They stop before the first champion’s two-hour accreditation floor.
A full board waits rather than banking arrivals. Declining and delivery never instantly replace a job.
Third-champion automation and high gold prices slow the transition to unattended production. Already paid queues still finish.

New inventions have direct mechanical regression coverage: anvil chains and queued finishing, slag returns, ore blasts, sieve overflow, premium metal, extra-life bell, defeat insurance, resting staff, supper, collector cooldown and inherited starts.
limits: Full earned multi-day campaign timing has not been rerun after the new commission clock and automation gates. Historical 4.0 campaign timings are labelled accordingly.
Opening runs used a deterministic policy that does not optimally plan every new invention or rare premium-grade request.
The test browser runs the portable edition over HTTP; direct file opening remains unverified.
